label: TP
reason: User input flows from getParameterValues through doSomething() to bar variable, then is HTML-encoded and printed to response. The replace() operation in doSomething() is ineffective (replaces entire string with Z, not proper sanitization), and encodeForHTML() only encodes after the data has already reached the sink location. The XSS vulnerability exists on the reported path.

evidence.note: user input flows to sink via encodeForHTML(bar)
